339-677-5434-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-1116-2464-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1116-2464-3249--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-1116-2464-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2281-3899-5237.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
2281-3899-5237.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

4871-6705-7824.description:
Activate Quina by paying {2} and sacrificing a Frog.
When the Frog dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens due to Quina and Bard.
Resolve the Quina ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

4050-4772-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-4772-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

193-2369-2724-3080-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
193-2369-2724-3080-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

3705-5231-5997-7646.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

997-3738-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
997-3738-6972.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2639-3254-4050-7489.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-7489.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Matterbending Mage and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Matterbending Mage enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Matterbending Mage and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-7489.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

147-6797-7335.easyPrerequisites: There is a valid target for Pain 101 on the battlefield.
147-6797-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

Empyrial Archangel redirects all damage that would be dealt to you or a permanent you control to it.
Because Rune-Tail's Essence prevents any damage that would be dealt to Empyrial Archangel, no damage can be dealt to you or permanents you control.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

Activate Morselhoarder by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3581-3941-4331-4993.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3773-3967-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1170-1329-1414-2905.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Pestermite.
When Pestermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2478-2854-4316-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2478-2854-4316-4574.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2173-5220-6539-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

4716-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4716-5641-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

486-509-2904-6499.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
486-509-2904-6499.notablePrerequisites:
The top card of your library has a higher mana value than the top cards of each opponent's library.
You have a way to choose one or more targets, as well as additional legal targets for that spell or ability.
486-509-2904-6499.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Psychic Battle to become an artifact.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Psychic Battle until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Choose any number of targets by any method.
Idris triggers, causing each player to reveal the top card of their library and changing the target(s) of the spell or ability to Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist and Idris trigger.
Resolve the Cephalid Illusionist trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing each player to reveal the top card of their library and changing the target(s) of the spell or ability to any other target.
Repeat from step 5.

222-527-1251-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1354-1835-3129-4275.notablePrerequisites: Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
1354-1835-3129-4275.description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Zaxara triggers, creating two 0/0 Hydra creature tokens.
The Hydras enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Faces of the Past trigger twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the second Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 0/0 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurm enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Wurm dies, Faces of the Past triggers, either tapping or untapping all Wurms.
Repeat.

1976-3532-3594-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2366-3827-5022.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of creatures that can tap to produce at least {3}{R/W}{R/W}.
Treasury Thrull does not have summoning sickness.
Treasury Thrull and the mana-producing creatures cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2366-3827-5022.description:
Declare Treasury Thrull and the mana-producing creatures as attackers.
Treasury Thrull triggers, returning Dryad Arbor to your hand from your graveyard.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Dryad Arbor, untapping all creatures that attacked this turn, and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Activate the mana-producing creatures by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R/W}{R/W}.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Treasury Thrull as an attacker.
Repeat from step 2.

202-3350.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is zero or less.
202-3350.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers, causing your life total to be swapped with target opponent's life total.
Lich causes your life total to stay the same, and instead draw cards equal to the opponent's life total when Axis of Mortality resolved.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

3510-3703-5147.notablePrerequisites: An additional land card in hand.
3510-3703-5147.description:
Play a land.
Sporemound triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling token that is also a Forest.
Repeat step 2 any number of times.
Activate Goblin Bombardment any number of times by sacrificing any number of creatures, dealing any amount of damage to any targets.
